title: Loupe
description: A loupe with no ring and no frame, only glass: slide it over a film print on a black desk in a low sun. The lens bends the print at its edge, splits the light into a thin fringe and burns the sun to a hot point beside it with a cone of rays; turn it from 1.5× to 4× to look into the macaws, the face paint, the hibiscus or the lighthouse.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: a lens drawn only by refraction and light, with chromatic fringe and a focused hot spot over a real film photograph, magnifying only as far as the scan still holds up.
sources: Prints: Kodak Lossless True Color Image Suite (kodim07, kodim15, kodim21, kodim23), 35mm film scans from Kodak Photo CD PCD0992, released by the Eastman Kodak Company for unrestricted usage; via https://github.com/MohamedBakrAli/Kodak-Lossless-True-Color-Image-Suite (mirror of http://r0k.us/graphics/kodak/)
